architecture: Historical hourly demand → LSTM branch + XGBoost branch → stacking meta-model → hybrid prediction

meta_model.validation_strategy: Chronological validation slice after train; meta never sees test targets
meta_model.why_selected: Ridge/LinearRegression is a transparent, low-complexity stacker that learns how to blend LSTM sequence forecasts with XGBoost structured forecasts plus light temporal context, without overfitting small validation sets.

lstm.architecture: Input → LSTM → Dropout → LSTM → Dense → Demand
lstm.input: Scaled sliding windows of hourly demand + temporal features

xgboost.role: Capture structured relationships among temporal / lag features

preprocessing: Operational source resolution (StopAnalytics / Bookings / bus schedule occupancy)
Temporal feature engineering (hour, day_of_week, month, holiday)
MinMax scaling fit on training split only
data.why_not_standalone_xgboost_artifact: Standalone Admin→XGBoost uses trip-level BusSchedule_structured_trip_demand (timestamp+route). Standalone LSTM uses hourly system demand. Those prediction spaces are incompatible. Hybrid therefore trains both branches on the same hourly operational series with identical chronological partitions.

split_method: Chronological 70% train / 15% validation / 15% test; no shuffle
leakage_prevention: No random shuffle of time series
MinMaxScaler fit on train period only
LSTM and XGBoost trained on train period only
Meta-model trained only on validation-period base predictions
Test targets never used to fit scaler, base models, or meta-model
Lag / rolling features use shift (past only)
insights: Hybrid stacking used operational hourly demand (StopAnalytics_hourly_operational_demand) labeled REAL / OPERATIONAL.
On the shared test set: LSTM MAE=10.6462, XGBoost MAE=0.1714, Hybrid MAE=0.1608.
Best model by test MAE: Hybrid.
Hybrid reduced MAE vs LSTM by 10.4854.
Hybrid reduced MAE vs XGBoost by 0.0106.
Largest hybrid absolute error on test: 2.57 at 2026-08-21 21:00 IST (System-wide).
Meta-model was fit only on validation-period base predictions; test labels were never used for stacking weights.

best.criterion: Lowest test MAE (then RMSE, then highest R2)

improvement.note: For MAE/RMSE/MAPE, positive delta means hybrid error is lower (improved). For R², positive delta means hybrid R² is higher (improved).
